_comment: Country-specific display configuration for Mongolia. Surfaces provenance strings and source refs to the dashboard so country-specific text does not need to live in TypeScript. A second country should drop a `{country}-country-config.json` alongside its targets file with the same shape.

docProvenance.NDC: Mongolia NDC v2 (2019), Government Decree No. 407 of 19 Nov 2019
docProvenance.NAP: Mongolia NAP, completed 2024 (per BTR1 Section 3.9.1.8, Table III.8)
docProvenance.SECTORAL: Vision 2050 Long-term Development Policy, Parliament Resolution 52, May 2020

_documentTypesComment: Mongolia's document-type registry. These entries MUST reproduce the labels and colors that were previously hardcoded in src/lib/utils.ts (DOC_LABELS/DOC_COLORS/DOC_MEDIUM_LABELS/DOC_FULL_LABELS) verbatim so Mongolia's dashboard display is unchanged after the open-PolicyDocumentType migration. BTR and OTHER are reserved tokens with universal fallbacks in src/lib/utils.ts but are declared here explicitly for clarity.
